About Arweave

Arweave is a decentralized storage network designed for permanent data storage paid with a single up-front fee in AR.

Where this AR price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Binance (AR/USDT) and Kraken (AR/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 65,454,200 AR (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
